parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US: English

parameters.name: AddressId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the address.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: EnableStatus
parameters.description:
The enabled status of the address:

- enable: The address can be used for DNS resolution if its health check is normal.

- disable: The address cannot be used for DNS resolution, regardless of its health check status.
